payload.title: Vehicle Builder Socket Prep UX / 차량 메시 소켓 준비 UX
payload.next_action: VSPUX-P0-02 minimal C++ implementation from VehicleSocketPrepUXPlan.md v0.1.5 §4.9 (authoritative required scope), §4.7 (Hardpoint Category), §4.8 (layout resilience). P1-01: isolate programmatic Browser refresh Direct selection/highlight from user selection; prevent implicit ViewModel->SelectVehicle re-selection; inspect ViewModel->RefreshVehicles/AuthoringViewModel->RefreshBrowser and test preservation of Quick mode/mesh/category and legacy selection/Step/draft across refresh. Explicit user row selection and +new vehicle exit Quick and perform normal action once. P1-02: separate Quick presentation host from existing recipe-owned Step3 HardpointPlanningHost, mutually exclusive visibility; reuse socket validation/naming/transaction functions, not Recipe writers or shared UI host. Quick socket refresh live mesh only, Step3 existing refresh retained. P2-01: user UX layout unfinalized until P0-04 actual editor review; do not build historical coordinate panels/filter/search or new frameworks. Wheel role exact4, category dynamic 7 currently supported extensible, HP_<Category>_<NN> max+1 from live mesh, no automatic Save/Recipe/VehicleData mutation. P0-03 UE 5.8 Source Editor Build + focused tests and UI smoke; P0-04 USER layout review and local presentation-only edits with revalidation. No Source/UE Asset/Build/Automation/PIE/USER Acceptance occurred for this design correction.

provenance.resolution_basis: Read-only design audit found P1-01 implicit re-select due to HandleRefreshVehicles SetSelection Direct -> HandleVehicleSelectionChanged -> ViewModel SelectVehicle and potential RefreshBrowser/RebuildStepStates side effects; P1-02 risk of reusing existing Step3 recipe HardpointPlanningHost for Quick. P2-01 historical coordinate-centric section could be misread as active implementation. Plan v0.1.5 §4.9 now is sole required scope and verification contract; no C++/UE asset/test/build changes; all unrelated dirty preserved.
